question: Are any a children museum located within 160 kilometers range of Bay Drive Park, Okee, WI?
sql: SELECT Pois.poi_name FROM pois AS Pois WHERE (Pois.tourism = 'museum' AND Pois.poi_name ILIKE '%children%') AND ST_DWithin( Pois.geometry::geography, ( SELECT P.geometry::geography FROM parks AS P WHERE P.park_name ILIKE '%Bay Drive Park%' AND ST_Intersects(P.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Okee%' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ), 160 * 1000 );
